definitions.explanation: Artificial eyelashes glued along the lash line to make the eyes look bigger. Often shortened to つけま in casual speech.

examples.japanese: つけまつげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける。
つけまつげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ちゃった。
examples.english: One of my false eyelashes came off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つけまつげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: When I go on stage, I wear false eyelashes to make my eyes look bigger.

notes:
From ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach) and まつげ (eyelashes); also written {付|つ}けまつげ or {付|つ}け{睫毛|まつげ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つけまつげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to put on false eyelashes
- つけまつげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off false eyelashes
- つけまつげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: false eyelashes come off

RELATED WORDS:
- まつげエクステ (マツエク): eyelash extensions, attached lash by lash at a salon
- ⟦マスカラ→マスカラ：31322_masukara⟧: mascara
